fields.value: Approximately 87 bpm (conditional mean-interval estimate). Selected positive tips have visibly unequal spacing, with longer gaps interspersed among shorter gaps. Upright spikes with grouped shorter intervals separated by longer gaps; small precomplex and intercomplex bumps. Grouped spacing supports comparing timing patterns but does not preferentially support Wenckebach. Atrial timing variation, premature events and nonconduction cannot be distinguished without a verified atrial and ventricular sequence. Runs of shorter gaps separated by longer gaps motivate a grouped-beating comparison. No uniform P sequence, progressive PR lengthening or demonstrably nonconducted P is established; grouped ventricular timing alone is insufficient. The selected QRS uncertainty envelope crosses 0.12 s and establishes no narrow/wide or normal/abnormal class. PR remains withheld.
